name: Underwear
overview: Scripture reveals that underwear, specifically linen breeches, served both practical and sacred purposes in ancient Israel. The priests wore linen garments and breeches to cover their nakedness and maintain holiness while ministering at the altar, emphasizing purity and consecration (Exodus 28:42; Leviticus 6:10; 16:4; Ezekiel 44:17). Additionally, God’s law distinguished proper attire by gender, forbidding men and women from wearing each other's garments as an abomination (Deuteronomy 22:5). The symbolic removal of sackcloth from the loins in Isaiah 20:2 further illustrates the cultural and spiritual significance of clothing around the loins.
